strategy.summary: PR #1164 ('Misc fixes') adjusts libmp/libmpf.py: it changes blog2_10 from 3.3219280948873626 to 3.321928094887362 (more accurate log2(10)=3.32192809488736235), adds a per-base log2 table used by repr_dps(), and (per the only test change) makes to_str/related conversion helpers validate an unsupported base by raising ValueError. On the buggy commit 46e0959d the added assertion `pytest.raises(ValueError, lambda: to_str(x, 6, base=42))` in mpmath/tests/test_convert.py::test_to_str is not satisfied, so test_to_str fails. Reproduce by installing mpmath from the checked-out tree and running the single test; it must fail at the buggy revision and pass once the fix is applied.

strategy.summary: At buggy commit 017cc473fb22f1fc1f7477d7ec1ce19a1b50d61e, mpmath/visualization.py rounds the per-axis grid size with M=int(ctx.sqrt(points*dre/dim)+1) (same for N), which overshoots by one whenever the square root is already an integer. strategy.summary: PR #966 bundles two fixes: (a) int()/round() of infinity must raise OverflowError instead of ValueError (libmpf.py), and (b) __format__ must accept format specs with leading zeros (issue 915, e.g. '.016f' and '0030f'). At the buggy commit 75b52a3, the newly added test cases mpmath/tests/test_format.py::test_mpf_fmt_cpython (@example(fmt='.016f', x=0.1) and @example(fmt='0030f', x=0.3)) and mpmath/tests/test_basic_ops.py::test_round_bulk (round of inf must raise OverflowError) are expected to fail; reproduce by installing the repo from source and running pytest on those selectors, without applying any fix.
